Jacqueline Clark is an attorney at the firm Envision Family Law located in Bellevue, Washington. She focuses her practice on family law matters, including child custody , divorce, legal separation , committed intimate relationships , adoption and military family law . Her personal experience has made her aware of the challenges that come with handling a family law matter, and she is an empathetic and caring lawyer who is steadfastly committed to acting in the best interests of her clients.

Ms. Clark serves clients in western Washington with an emphasis on King and Pierce counties. In addition to Washington, she is also authorized to practice in Ontario, Canada. She practiced family law in Canada for over seven years before coming to the United States. While there, she had the honor of appearing before the British Columbia Court of Appeal about a Hague Convention child abduction case.

With a bachelor’s in management and international business, Ms. Clark graduated from the McGill University in Canada. She then went on to receive her Bachelor of Laws degree in 1994 from the same university. When she moved to the U.S., she pursued her Master of Laws degree for Foreign Attorneys in 2018 at the Seattle University.

In 2021, Ms. Clark passed the bar exam and received her license from the Washington State Bar Association. In addition to her legal education, she received training to become a life coach from the Robbins-Madanes Center for Strategic Intervention. She distinguishes out among attorneys since she is both a certified life coach and an attorney.

Ms. Clark’s experience as a life coach helps her to understand the dynamics of families, keep disputes civil, and support her clients as they navigate the legal and emotional complexities of family law cases.
